no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not presented at an advisory committee because efficacy was robust and potential safety/tolerability issues can be readily monitored and managed. In addition, this product had breakthrough therapy designation for prevention of CMV infection/disease in CMV seropositive patients undergoing allogeneic HSCT. Products with breakthrough designation often have clinical benefit that clearly outweighs risks for a population of unmet medical need and an Advisory Committee is not warranted.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for letermovir (PREVYMIS, NDA209940, reviewed jointly with NDA209939). The FDA review documents state the application was not presented to an AdComm because efficacy was robust, safety/tolerability issues could be readily monitored and managed, and the product held Breakthrough Therapy Designation for CMV prevention in seropositive allogeneic HSCT recipients. The Cross-Discipline Team Leader and Medical reviews independently confirm no advisory committee or external consultation was held.
